Unit costs (landed + fulfillment + warranty accrual on posted price) are A $58.438606 and B $58.670542, giving margins A $47.164572 and B $60.736164. Kept units after 7.055373% returns are A 99,746.666076 and B 78,354.471262. Local annual profit after fixed costs: A $4.434639m; B $4.184629m. Thus A is the Branch 2 local-profit choice, ahead by about $0.250010m. For the company pairing, the shared record sets rho=0.00, so interaction terms do not alter local profit comparison; the branch-1 choice still affects which Branch 2 label/pairing is aligned, but the direct interaction contribution is zero under the lock.
